extensions.name: Shopify
extensions.subtitle: Deliver Shopify orders with your own fleet
extensions.description: Every paid Shopify order becomes a Fleet-Ops delivery. Customers get live tracking, your drivers get the job in the Navigator app, and Shopify is updated when it's delivered.
extensions.notes: Local delivery zones from Shopify are matched to your service areas, and partial fulfilments are supported.
highlights: Orders arrive in Fleet-Ops the moment they're paid
Live tracking links on the Shopify order page
Delivery rates at checkout from your service areas
Fulfilment status written back to Shopify
No per-order fees
setup_steps: Connect your store under Shopify → Settings
Choose which delivery methods create orders
Pick the default order type and pickup location

extensions.name: flespi
extensions.subtitle: Connect almost any GPS tracker
extensions.description: Bring GPS trackers and telematics devices of almost any make into Fleet-Ops through flespi. Messages are parsed into positions, trips and events in real time.
extensions.notes: Fuel level and ignition events are now mapped to Fleet-Ops sensors, and device imports are five times faster.
highlights: Hundreds of supported tracker models
Live positions on the Fleet-Ops map
Ignition, fuel and door events as sensors
Trip history for every device
setup_steps: Paste your flespi token under Telematics → flespi
Assign each device to a vehicle

extensions.name: WooCommerce
extensions.subtitle: Turn WooCommerce orders into deliveries
extensions.description: A WordPress plugin and a Fleetbase extension that work together. Orders flow into Fleet-Ops, shoppers see delivery rates at checkout and a tracking link in their order email.
extensions.notes: Delivery time slots at checkout and support for WooCommerce's block-based cart.
highlights: Orders sync both ways
Delivery rates and time slots at checkout
Tracking link in the order email
Works with self-hosted WordPress
setup_steps: Install the Fleetbase plugin in WordPress
Paste your Fleetbase API key into the plugin
Choose which shipping zones use Fleetbase

extensions.name: Samsara
extensions.subtitle: Vehicle data and location sync
extensions.description: Imports vehicles from Samsara and keeps their live locations in sync with Fleet-Ops, so dispatch sees every connected vehicle on one map.
extensions.notes: Odometer and engine hours are imported with each vehicle.

extensions.name: Lalamove
extensions.subtitle: On-demand couriers across Asia
extensions.description: Send a delivery to Lalamove when your own drivers are busy. Quotes, booking and live courier tracking happen inside the Fleet-Ops order.
extensions.notes: Multi-stop bookings and motorcycle, van and lorry service types.

extensions.name: Billing
extensions.subtitle: Subscriptions and usage billing for your platform
extensions.description: Charge your own customers for using your Fleetbase-powered platform: plans, subscriptions, usage-based billing and invoices across every organization.
extensions.notes: Metered billing by order volume and a customer billing portal.
highlights: Plans with monthly or yearly pricing
Usage-based billing by orders, drivers or vehicles
Invoices and receipts sent for you
Stripe payments built in
setup_steps: Connect your Stripe account under Billing → Settings
Assign the plan to an organization

extensions.name: Uber Direct
extensions.subtitle: Overflow deliveries to Uber couriers
extensions.description: Hand a delivery to Uber Direct when your fleet is at capacity. Get a quote, book a courier and follow them on the Fleet-Ops map.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: DoorDash Drive
extensions.subtitle: Overflow deliveries to DoorDash couriers
extensions.description: Book a DoorDash courier from any Fleet-Ops order. Quotes, courier assignment and proof of delivery come back to the order automatically.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: Traccar
extensions.subtitle: Positions from your Traccar server
extensions.description: Forward positions and events from a Traccar server to Fleet-Ops. Works with every device Traccar supports, on your own infrastructure.
extensions.notes: Geofence and alarm events are forwarded as Fleet-Ops events.

extensions.name: Teltonika
extensions.subtitle: Direct ingest for Teltonika trackers
extensions.description: Point Teltonika FMB, FMC and FMM trackers straight at Fleetbase. No gateway in between: positions, ignition and CAN data arrive in Fleet-Ops.
extensions.notes: CAN bus fuel and RPM readings for FMC devices.

extensions.name: LocoNav
extensions.subtitle: Fleet telematics integration
extensions.description: Brings LocoNav vehicle tracking and telematics data into Fleetbase, with live positions and trip history for every connected vehicle.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: Odoo
extensions.subtitle: Dispatch Odoo delivery orders
extensions.description: Odoo delivery orders become Fleet-Ops orders with a driver, a route and proof of delivery. Status and signatures are written back to the transfer in Odoo.
extensions.notes: Batch transfers and return pickings.

extensions.name: ERPNext
extensions.subtitle: Deliver ERPNext delivery notes
extensions.description: Delivery notes and delivery trips from ERPNext are dispatched through Fleet-Ops, with driver tracking and proof of delivery sent back to ERPNext.
extensions.notes: Delivery trips keep their stop order.

extensions.name: QuickBooks Online
extensions.subtitle: Sync Ledger invoices to QuickBooks
extensions.description: Invoices, payments and customers from Ledger are kept in step with QuickBooks Online, so your accountant never re-keys a delivery invoice.
extensions.notes: First release.
highlights: Invoices and payments sync automatically
Customers matched by email
Tax codes mapped once
setup_steps: Sign in to QuickBooks under Ledger → Integrations
Map your income and tax accounts

extensions.name: Xero
extensions.subtitle: Sync Ledger invoices to Xero
extensions.description: Send Ledger invoices and payments to Xero as they happen, with customers and tax rates matched for you.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: WhatsApp Notifications
extensions.subtitle: Delivery updates on WhatsApp
extensions.description: Send order confirmations, driver-on-the-way messages and tracking links through WhatsApp Business, in your customer's language.
extensions.notes: Message templates per order type, and replies are attached to the order.
highlights: Approved templates for each delivery stage
Tracking link in every message
Customer replies land on the order
setup_steps: Choose which order activities send a message

extensions.name: n8n
extensions.subtitle: Automate Fleetbase with n8n workflows
extensions.description: Trigger n8n workflows from Fleetbase events and let workflows create orders, assign drivers and update customers. Self-hosted, like your Fleetbase.
extensions.notes: Triggers for order, driver and vehicle events.

extensions.name: Zapier
extensions.subtitle: Connect Fleetbase to 7,000 apps
extensions.description: Create orders from a spreadsheet row, a form or a CRM deal, and send delivery events to the apps your team already uses.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: Square
extensions.subtitle: Deliver Square online and POS orders
extensions.description: Delivery orders from Square Online and Square for Restaurants are dispatched to your own drivers, with overflow to a courier network when you need it.
extensions.notes: First release.

extensions.name: Solid
extensions.subtitle: Store and share data with Solid pods
extensions.description: Uses the Solid protocol to store and share Fleetbase data in pods your customers and partners control, with access they can revoke.
extensions.notes: Sign-in with any Solid identity provider.

extensions.name: Driver Scorecards
extensions.subtitle: Safety and on-time scores for every driver
extensions.description: Scores each driver on harsh braking, speeding, idling and on-time delivery, with a weekly report for fleet managers.
extensions.notes: Coaching notes on each scorecard and a leaderboard by fleet.
highlights: One score per driver, updated daily
Weekly email report
Leaderboards by fleet
setup_steps: Choose which events count towards the score
Pick who receives the weekly report

extensions.name: Fuel Cards
extensions.subtitle: Match fuel card spend to vehicles
extensions.description: Imports fuel card transactions and matches each one to a vehicle and driver, flagging fills that don't fit the tank or the route.
extensions.notes: CSV import for three more card providers.

extensions.name: Cold Chain Monitor
extensions.subtitle: Temperature alerts for chilled loads
extensions.description: Watches temperature and door sensors on refrigerated vehicles, alerts dispatch before a load is at risk and attaches the temperature log to proof of delivery.
extensions.notes: Rebuilt for the next Fleetbase release, with per-compartment thresholds.

extensions.name: Managed Optimizer
extensions.subtitle: Route optimization with nothing to host
extensions.description: Fleetbase runs the optimizer for you. Plans for thousands of stops with live traffic, with no routing servers to look after.
extensions.notes: Live traffic in more regions.
